title: Chapter 182: New Zerg Troops Join The Battle
content:
Chapter 182: New Zerg Troops Join The Battle

The underground rat archers behind the ghouls began to throw a large number of armor-piercing heavy arrows at the area where the Zerg cockroaches were located, which caused many armor-piercing heavy arrows to be inserted into the bodies of the 10 cockroaches.

However, such damage did not have much impact on the Zerg cockroaches with strong defense and super self-healing ability.

Wu Qing felt that the cockroaches gathered together to fight like this, which was easy to be targeted by the opponent's long-range attack troops, so he let the 10 cockroaches disperse and each cooperate with the surrounding Zerg puppies to fight together.

The Zerg cockroaches cooperated with the puppies to fight, and from time to time they sprayed a mouthful of fire on the gathered ghouls, which could greatly assist the attack of the Zerg puppies. The ghouls sprayed by the cockroach flames would have a great impact on their combat power, and some directly lost their combat ability.

Some ghouls endured the double damage of fire and corrosion, and rushed to the cockroaches, trying to attack the cockroaches, but unfortunately they were facing the knife arms pierced by the cockroach bullets. Few melee creatures could withstand the penetration of the cockroach knife arms.

The cockroaches, with strong defense and sharp attack, are not afraid of close combat at all!

Although the attack of the Zerg cockroaches can also cause certain damage to the Zerg puppies, as long as the two arms cooperate well, the combat efficiency will be greatly improved!

With the cockroaches, the Zerg's medium and short-range combat capabilities have been further strengthened, especially in close combat, the Zerg has another choice besides using the puppies to fight consumption.

10 cockroaches have been fighting side by side with the Zerg puppies on the front line, sometimes spraying flames, sometimes slashing out knife arms, even if they are scarred, they just stand firm.

When the cockroaches are besieged and in mortal danger, the Zerg puppies will rush up to rescue them, and the stealth spiders lurking underground will also assist with ground spikes.

As long as they get out of danger, it won't take long for the Zerg cockroaches to be full of energy again and can continue to participate in the battle.

The name of the Zerg cockroach is indeed not wrong, its vitality is extremely tenacious!

…

Wu Qing was very satisfied with the performance of the new Zerg Cockroach. He asked the Queen to record the test data of the Cockroach and then turned his attention to the Destroyers who were on standby.

10 Destroyers were ready to attack behind the Zerg Hydralisk phalanx. Their huge bodies were more than three times larger than the Hydralisk.

The Destroyer's huge body was to accommodate the ultra-long-range jet cavity on its back, provide sufficient jet kinetic energy, and reserve enough ammunition.

"Bang Bang Bang...!"

Under Wu Qing's command, the 10 Destroyers launched an attack on the underground rat archers behind the enemy.

Highly compressed liquid fireballs were shot out from the jet cavity on the back of the Destroyer. The fireballs drew beautiful arcs and landed accurately in the dense phalanx of underground rat archers.

"Boom boom boom...!"

The explosion, which was not much less powerful than the fireball of the three-star flame demon of the demon clan, swept everything around!

The scorching energy impact, mixed with the splash of highly corrosive high-temperature viscous liquid, the large fireballs fired by the ten destroyers caused a large number of casualties to the underground rat archers!

The sophisticated equipment on the underground rat archers melted like chocolate under such high temperature and corrosion!

The well-trained underground rat archers, suddenly suffered such an attack, and also messed up their formation and involuntarily moved away from the explosion area.

The Zerg destroyer is the first real long-range attack unit of the Zerg.

In Wu Qing's view, the hydralisk can only be regarded as a unit with guns, and the destroyer is a unit with cannons. In his mind, cannons are long-range attack weapons.

The disadvantage of the Zerg destroyer is that the firing rate is slow, which is not a disadvantage. All units and weapons of this type have this problem.

The reloading preparation before the siege weapon is fired, the charging and fire control before the three-star flame demon attacks, the Zerg destroyer also needs to charge. The longer the charging, the longer the range.

The real world is not a game, and the firing rate is not fixed. It will change according to the distance of the target.

The underground rat archers are just outside the range of the Zerg Hydralisks. For the Zerg Destroyers, the distance is not far, so their firing rate is not slow.

"Boom boom boom...!"

Ten fireballs flew into the underground rat archer square, blowing up an area in the square into a no-man's land.

"Queen of Worms, the performance of these two arms is very good. Let's finalize it first, and then optimize it when there is a better improvement plan in the future!"

Wu Qing asked the Queen of Worms to add the genes of the new Zerg cockroach to the larvae, and in the cockroach and destroyer research buildings, the upgrade option of evolving cockroaches into destroyers was upgraded, and all other upgrade options for improving abilities were also upgraded.

The Queen of Worms' research on arms is not done out of thin air. It will first use worker bees to build a Zerg building, and conduct research and experimental work related to arms in this building.

After the Queen's research is completed, if this unit is finally finalized, this research building will be the research and upgrade building for the corresponding unit.

This is the same as the hatching pool of the puppies, the hydralisk's hydralisk nest, and the queen's queen nest.

After the Queen has completed this series of work, the finalization of the new unit of the Zerg cockroach is completed. Wu Qing can hatch cockroaches through larvae like other units, and can evolve cockroaches into destroyers.

Wu Qing stopped hatching the dragons, and the number of dragons at this time was close to .

Now there are two battlefields providing resources at the same time. The gas resources are temporarily sufficient. The large amount of gas beads brought back by the transport host from the Naga tribe have not yet been converted into gas resources.

As long as the troops that need gas resources are not hatched on a large scale, the Zerg will not be short of gas resources in a short time.

Wu Qing hatched 3,000 cockroaches with a wave of his hand, and chose to evolve 1,000 of them into destroyers.

2,000 Zerg cockroaches and 1,000 destroyers consumed the gas resources at once.

Wu Qing felt that it was worth it. These Zerg cockroaches and destroyers joined the battlefield of the underground world, which would instantly reverse the situation, offset the impact of the underground rat army's participation in the war, and increase the Zerg's killing efficiency against the ghouls.

When 2,000 cockroaches rushed to the front line, they dispersed and fought together with the Zerg puppies and stealth spiders.

Lines of fire sprayed on the rushing ghouls. The ghouls that could barely fight against the Zerg puppies were either dead or injured. They were vulnerable to the Zerg puppies.

The ground spikes of the stealth spiders can also kill ghouls more easily.

The battle line, which had been relatively stable, was pushed forward a long distance by the Zerg cockroaches and puppies, and the entire Zerg defense line was expanded.

1,000 destroyers joined the team of 10 destroyers. They lined up behind the Zerg Hydralisk phalanx and launched a fierce attack on the underground ratman archers who had retreated a certain distance.

When 1,010 large fireballs fell on the phalanx of underground ratman archers, a terrifying chain explosion occurred!

For the first time, the underground ratman archers suffered a large-scale reduction in personnel, and all the underground ratman archers participating in the battle began to retreat.

The Zerg destroyers' attack followed the footsteps of the underground ratman archers and extended forward until they drove the underground ratman archers out of the combat area before stopping.

The underground ratman archers now have a range that can no longer reach the Zerg puppies and cockroaches fighting on the front line, and can no longer provide long-range support to the ghouls.

The range of the Zerg destroyers is far from reaching its limit. They can easily attack the underground ratman archers, but it is no longer necessary. Wu Qing needs them to temporarily hide their true range. It is enough to drive the underground ratman archers out of the combat area.

Faced with such a situation, the ghouls did not retreat, and a large number of ghouls continued to attack the Zerg's defense line.

The Zerg destroyers set their attack targets on the ghoul assembly area, and large fireballs kept falling, blowing up the ghouls and wounded all over the ground, turning them into countless lights.

Those evil-eyed little guys had long since withdrawn from the battlefield area, and they were not even needed to defend against the Zerg flying dragons, so they suffered the least losses.

With the participation of Zerg cockroaches and destroyers, underground ratmen and evil eyes were driven out of the battlefield, and the casualties of ghouls increased dramatically.

But ghouls are not afraid of casualties. They are betting on the attack limit of the new Zerg troops. Such a powerful attack will definitely consume a lot of energy, and no one can attack continuously.

At the end of the war, it is hard power that counts, not some powerful troops and advanced weapons that can determine the outcome of the war.

The ghouls think that their strength is strong enough!

Wu Qing doesn't want to force the ghouls too much. These ghouls obviously have independent wisdom. It would be bad if they beat others to dare not fight.

Moreover, the overall strength of the Zerg at this time is indeed not as good as that of the ghouls. If it were not for the battlefield restrictions, the Zerg would not be able to beat the ghouls at all.

Under the command of the Queen of the Zerg, the Zerg army began to test the best efficiency point of the battle line, that is, to effectively kill the enemy, to ensure the continuous combat time of the Zerg, and not to overdo it and scare the enemy away.

A group of Zerg dragons flew over quickly from high altitude and quickly withdrew from the underground world.

Their continuous attacks have almost reached their physical limits. Forcibly transmitting energy through the Zerg network to continue fighting will greatly reduce combat efficiency. Unless under special circumstances, the Zerg will generally not choose this method to maintain combat power.

Another group of Zerg dragons entered the underground world, carrying ten queen three-star hosts, wandering around the ghoul territory, constantly bombing and reconnaissance.

The number of Zerg dragons at this time is enough for rotation.

They do not go deep into the underground world. As long as they circle around the area near the battlefield, it is not a good choice to aim too high before the ghouls are dealt with.

Only the queen will release reconnaissance parasites on some creatures that look more special. The Zerg use these creatures to collect information about the underground world in depth.

The queen reduced the attack frequency of cockroaches and destroyers, and adjusted the battle line to a position where not many Zerg puppies are consumed. In this way, as long as a small number of Zerg puppies are added, the battle line can be maintained and endless ghouls can be harvested.

The ghouls seemed to see the Zerg's weakness and their attack became more fierce.
